tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Action Battery Wholesalers website for stationary batteries from BAE, Deka and NorthStar, chargers, DC power systems and UPS equipment: its pages and the manufacturers' datasheets and a few product flyers. Ask in plain words, e.g. "12 V AGM battery for telecom" or "Deka Unigy I 12AVR100 d

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read the full text of one result from search, find_series or get_documents (a web page, a PDF, or a product series) with its link.

tools.name: find_series
tools.description: Find a battery or product series that Action Battery Wholesalers offers by chemistry (VRLA AGM, VRLA gel, flooded, pure lead), nominal voltage (2 V, 6 V, 12 V, 48 V) or application (telecom, utility, UPS, solar, switchgear). Returns each series with its product page and documents.

tools.name: get_documents
tools.description: List the documents Action Battery Wholesalers links for a series, or of one type across the site. Almost all are manufacturers' datasheets (type datasheet); a few are product flyers (type brochure). The website publishes no SDS, discharge tables, manuals, certificates or warranty documents.

tools.name: quote_request
tools.description: How to ask Action Battery Wholesalers for a quote or price: the address to write to, and what to include so the engineers can answer without a round of questions. It sends nothing; the customer sends the request themselves.

tools.name: sizing_tool
tools.description: Action Battery Wholesalers has NO online sizing tool, and this connector cannot size a system. This says how to get one sized: the customer sends the load, runtime and voltage with a quote request and the engineers size it.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
